results.sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'BCC_B2'
   OR s.prototype = 'B2'
   OR s.strukturbericht = 'B2'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.number_of_elements
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.number_of_elements >= 3
ORDER BY m.number_of_elements DESC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS nacl_type_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'NaCl' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B1')
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, m.reduced_formula, m.source_db, m.source_material_id
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al'
ORDER BY m.entry_id
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group = 'Pm-3m'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS oqmd_entry_count
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.source_db = 'OQMD'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ti(-|$)'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'BiF3' OR s.strukturbericht IN ('BiF3', 'D03', 'D0_3')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Pt'
  AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.25
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_al WHERE c_al.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_al.element = 'Al')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_rh WHERE c_rh.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_rh.element = 'Rh')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Y|La|Ce|Pr|Nd|Pm|Sm|Eu|Gd|Tb|Dy|Ho|Er|Tm|Yb|Lu)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '^(Ag|Au|Cd|Co|Cr|Cu|Fe|Hf|Hg|Ir|Mn|Mo|Nb|Ni|Os|Pd|Pt|Re|Rh|Ru|Sc|Ta|Tc|Ti|V|W|Y|Zn|Zr)(-(Ag|Au|Cd|Co|Cr|Cu|Fe|Hf|Hg|Ir|Mn|Mo|Nb|Ni|Os|Pd|Pt|Re|Rh|Ru|Sc|Ta|Tc|Ti|V|W|Y|Zn|Zr))*$'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND c.atomic_fraction = 0.75
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.site_label
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd')
ORDER BY m.formula, c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT c.element
FROM composition c
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Mn'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, e.atomic_number, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN element e ON e.symbol = c.element
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND e.atomic_number >= 40
ORDER BY m.formula, e.atomic_number
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_v
    WHERE c_v.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_v.element = 'V'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_al
    WHERE c_al.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_al.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.50 AND 3.60
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'B2' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B2')
  AND s.crystal_system IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(s.crystal_system) <> 'cubic'
ORDER BY s.crystal_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, s.lattice_c
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_c IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a <> s.lattice_c
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.strukturbericht, s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS space_group_225_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group_number = 225
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_c
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'NiAs'
  AND LOWER(s.crystal_system) = 'hexagonal'
ORDER BY s.lattice_c DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'B2' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B2')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a,
       STDDEV_SAMP(s.lattice_a) AS stddev_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, pde.is_on_hull, pde.hull_distance
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND pde.is_on_hull = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom > 0
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.prototype,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'B2' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B2')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0
  AND ps.energy_above_hull < 0.1
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS unstable_nacl_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'NaCl' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B1'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.band_gap > 0
ORDER BY ps.band_gap DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.band_gap, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.band_gap = 0
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, pde.hull_distance
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
ORDER BY pde.hull_distance, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.5
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.reduced_formula,
  AVG(pde.hull_distance) AS avg_energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
GROUP BY m.reduced_formula
ORDER BY avg_energy_above_hull
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, calc.functional
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE calc.functional <> 'GGA-PBE'
ORDER BY calc.functional, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 200
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    cp.property_name,
    cp.tensor_component,
    cp.value,
    cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name ILIKE '%young%'
  AND cp.property_name ILIKE '%modulus%'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, et.poisson_ratio
FROM material_entry m
JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE et.poisson_ratio >= 0.3
ORDER BY et.poisson_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       cp_sm.value AS shear_modulus,
       cp_bm.value / NULLIF(cp_sm.value, 0) AS bg_ratio
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
JOIN calculated_property cp_sm ON cp_sm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_sm.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_sm.value > 0
  AND cp_bm.value / cp_sm.value >= 2.0
ORDER BY cp_bm.value / cp_sm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    et.is_stable AS elastic_is_stable
FROM elastic_tensor et
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.calculation_id = et.calculation_id
JOIN material_entry m ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
WHERE et.is_stable = FALSE
  AND calc.calculation_type = 'DFT'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, s.lattice_c, s.lattice_c / s.lattice_a AS c_a_ratio
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_c IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a > 0
ORDER BY s.lattice_c / s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.formula = 'Ni3Al'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       mp.total_magnetization
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND mp.total_magnetization <> 0
ORDER BY ABS(mp.total_magnetization) DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, dos.total_dos_at_fermi
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN density_of_states dos ON dos.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY dos.total_dos_at_fermi DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.formula,
       bs.cbm_energy - bs.vbm_energy AS band_gap_value,
       bs.is_direct_gap
FROM material_entry m
JOIN band_structure bs ON bs.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE bs.is_direct_gap = TRUE
ORDER BY band_gap_value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, dos.spin_polarized
FROM material_entry m
JOIN density_of_states dos ON dos.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE dos.spin_polarized = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, mp.magnetic_ordering
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND mp.magnetic_ordering = 'ferromagnetic'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, mp.curie_temperature_k
FROM material_entry m
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE mp.curie_temperature_k IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY mp.curie_temperature_k DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.formula, tp.debye_temperature_k
FROM material_entry m
JOIN thermal_property tp ON tp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE tp.debye_temperature_k >= 500
ORDER BY tp.debye_temperature_k DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    tp.temperature_k,
    tp.thermal_conductivity
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN thermal_property tp ON tp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND tp.thermal_conductivity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.formula, tp.temperature_k
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, tp.gruneisen_parameter
FROM material_entry m
JOIN thermal_property tp ON tp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE tp.gruneisen_parameter >= 2.0
ORDER BY tp.gruneisen_parameter DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, mp.magnetic_anisotropy_energy
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY mp.magnetic_anisotropy_energy DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    dos.is_metallic,
    mp.magnetic_ordering,
    mp.total_magnetization
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN density_of_states dos ON dos.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND dos.is_metallic = TRUE
    AND LOWER(mp.magnetic_ordering) IN ('ferromagnetic', 'fm')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, se.miller_index, se.surface_energy_j_m2
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN surface_energy se ON se.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND se.miller_index = '111'
ORDER BY se.surface_energy_j_m2 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.formula, se.miller_index, se.work_function
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN surface_energy se ON se.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND se.work_function >= 5.0
ORDER BY se.work_function DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, se.miller_index, se.is_reconstructed
FROM material_entry m
JOIN surface_energy se ON se.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE se.is_reconstructed = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula, se.miller_index
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, gb.sigma_value, gb.gb_energy_j_m2
FROM material_entry m
JOIN grain_boundary gb ON gb.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE gb.sigma_value = 5
  AND gb.gb_energy_j_m2 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    md.formation_energy,
    dt.defect_name,
    dt.category
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN material_defect md ON md.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN defect_type dt ON dt.defect_type_id = md.defect_type_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND (dt.category = 'vacancy' OR dt.defect_name ILIKE '%vacancy%')
ORDER BY md.formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, dt.category, dt.defect_name, md.site, md.concentration, md.formation_energy
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN material_defect md ON md.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN defect_type dt ON dt.defect_type_id = md.defect_type_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (dt.category ILIKE '%antisite%' OR dt.defect_name ILIKE '%antisite%')
ORDER BY m.formula, dt.defect_name, md.site
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, e.symbol AS dopant_element
FROM material_entry m
JOIN material_defect md ON md.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN element e ON e.element_id = md.dopant_element_id
WHERE e.symbol = 'B'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  dt.defect_name,
  dt.category,
  md.site,
  md.concentration,
  md.formation_energy
FROM material_entry m
JOIN material_defect md ON md.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN defect_type dt ON dt.defect_type_id = md.defect_type_id
WHERE dt.defect_name ILIKE '%interstitial%'
   OR dt.category ILIKE '%interstitial%'
ORDER BY m.formula, dt.defect_name
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  se100.surface_energy_j_m2 AS surface_energy_100_j_m2,
  se110.surface_energy_j_m2 AS surface_energy_110_j_m2
FROM material_entry m
JOIN surface_energy se100 ON se100.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN surface_energy se110 ON se110.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE se100.miller_index = '100'
  AND se110.miller_index = '110'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  s.volume_per_atom,
  (GREATEST(s.lattice_a, s.lattice_b, s.lattice_c) - LEAST(s.lattice_a, s.lattice_b, s.lattice_c)) AS lattice_parameter_deviation
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype IN ('L12', 'B2')
   OR s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'B2')
ORDER BY lattice_parameter_deviation DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN material_synthesis ms ON ms.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ms.success = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, sm.method_name
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN material_synthesis ms ON ms.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN synthesis_method sm ON sm.synthesis_id = ms.synthesis_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ms.success = TRUE
  AND sm.method_name ILIKE '%arc%melting%'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, ms.temperature_k
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN material_synthesis ms ON ms.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ms.temperature_k >= 1000
  AND ms.success = TRUE
ORDER BY ms.temperature_k DESC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN material_reference mr1 ON mr1.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN material_reference mr2 ON mr2.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN material_reference mr3 ON mr3.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND mr1.reference_id < mr2.reference_id
  AND mr2.reference_id < mr3.reference_id
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, m.chemical_system, ad.domain_name
FROM material_entry m
JOIN material_application ma ON ma.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN application_domain ad ON ad.domain_id = ma.domain_id
WHERE ad.domain_name ILIKE '%高温超合金%'
   OR ad.domain_name ILIKE '%superalloy%'
   OR ad.description ILIKE '%高温超合金%'
   OR ad.description ILIKE '%superalloy%'
ORDER BY ad.domain_name, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  lr.year,
  lr.title,
  lr.journal,
  lr.doi
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN material_reference mr ON mr.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN literature_reference lr ON lr.reference_id = mr.reference_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND lr.year >= 2020
ORDER BY lr.year DESC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, m.source_db
FROM material_entry m
JOIN material_synthesis ms ON ms.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ms.success = TRUE
  AND m.source_db IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, sm.method_name
FROM material_entry m
JOIN material_synthesis ms ON ms.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN synthesis_method sm ON sm.synthesis_id = ms.synthesis_id
WHERE ms.success = TRUE
  AND (
    sm.method_name ILIKE '%ball milling%'
    OR sm.description ILIKE '%ball milling%'
    OR sm.method_name ILIKE '%ボールミリング%'
    OR sm.description ILIKE '%ボールミリング%'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN material_application ma ON ma.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN application_domain ad ON ad.domain_id = ma.domain_id
WHERE ad.domain_name = '耐熱材料'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    lr.title,
    lr.authors,
    lr.journal,
    lr.year,
    lr.volume,
    lr.pages,
    lr.doi
FROM literature_reference lr
WHERE lr.doi IS NOT NULL
  AND lr.doi <> ''
ORDER BY lr.year DESC, lr.title
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) <= 0.05
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 150
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.prototype,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND (ps.is_stable = TRUE OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05)
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  tp.debye_temperature_k,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN thermal_property tp ON tp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 180
  AND tp.debye_temperature_k >= 400
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, tp.debye_temperature_k DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS shear_modulus, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.53 AND 3.59
  AND cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 70
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    mp.magnetic_ordering,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND (mp.magnetic_ordering ILIKE 'ferromagnetic' OR mp.magnetic_ordering = 'FM')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN material_synthesis ms ON ms.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ms.success = TRUE
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       cp_bulk.value AS bulk_modulus,
       cp_hull.value AS energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bulk ON cp_bulk.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_hull ON cp_hull.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_bulk.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp_hull.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_bulk.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      WHERE cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
        AND (m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp_hull.value <= 0.01
ORDER BY cp_bulk.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS stable_binary_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    et.poisson_ratio
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND et.poisson_ratio < 0.25
ORDER BY et.poisson_ratio ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.prototype,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    se.miller_index,
    se.surface_energy_j_m2
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN surface_energy se ON se.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND se.surface_energy_j_m2 < 1.5
ORDER BY se.surface_energy_j_m2 ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, AVG(cp.value) AS average_bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY average_bulk_modulus DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  AVG(cp.value) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_avg_bulk_modulus,
  AVG(cp.value) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_avg_bulk_modulus,
  AVG(cp.value) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE)
    - AVG(cp.value) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS avg_bulk_modulus_difference
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, COUNT(*) AS entry_count
FROM material_entry m
GROUP BY m.chemical_system
ORDER BY entry_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  calc.method,
  COUNT(DISTINCT calc.entry_id) AS entry_count
FROM calculation calc
WHERE calc.calculation_type = 'DFT'
GROUP BY calc.method
ORDER BY entry_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.band_gap AS band_gap_value,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.band_gap = 0 THEN 'zero'
    ELSE 'nonzero'
  END AS band_gap_category
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.band_gap IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY band_gap_category, ps.band_gap, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  (FLOOR(s.lattice_a / 0.1) * 0.1)::numeric(10,1) AS lattice_a_bin_start,
  ((FLOOR(s.lattice_a / 0.1) + 1) * 0.1)::numeric(10,1) AS lattice_a_bin_end,
  COUNT(*) AS lattice_a_count
FROM structure s
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY FLOOR(s.lattice_a / 0.1)
ORDER BY lattice_a_bin_start
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05) AS metastable_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05) AS unstable_count
FROM phase_stability ps
LIMIT 10000;
